BiblicalUsage: Joseph's brothers cast him into an empty pit, Pharaoh dreamed of seven empty ears blasted with the east wind, and he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that empty is never neutral in the Bible: the empty pit, the empty ear and the empty man all end in the same want.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; King Solomon
